title: On the identifiability of Dirichlet mixture models
summary: We study identifiability of finite mixtures of Dirichlet distributions on the interior of the simplex. We first prove a shift identity showing that every Dirichlet density can be written as a mixture of $J$ shifted Dirichlet densities, where $J-1$ is the dimension of the simplex support, which yields non-identifiability on the full parameter space. We then show that identifiability is recovered on a fixed-total parameter slice and on restricted box-type regions.
